name: Fast tri-cubic interpolation
definition: A technique to reconstruct a texture with a cubic B-spline filter at texture coordinate x by reducing the number of texture fetches required for the convolution sum of four weighted neighboring texels, using GPU linear filtering capabilities.
summary: Fast tri-cubic interpolation is a GPU-based scheme that reduces texture fetches from 64 to 8 by using separable 1D filters and pre-computed weights, differing from frequency domain methods by operating in the spatial domain.
